question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

The new government's domestic policies could easily __undermine__ the main foreign policy.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Enhance**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a word that means the opposite of another word.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
• The underlined word is **"undermine", which means to weaken or sabotage.**(कमजोर)
 
 
• Example: This could undermine years of hard work.
 
 
 
• **"Enhance" means ****to improve or strengthen something.**(बढ़ाना)
 
 
• ​Example: The drugs will enhance his quality of life.
 
 
 
• ​Thus, the word "enhance" is the antonym of the word "undermine."

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, Cripple, is a synonym of undermine and means to disable or cripple something. (अपंग)
 
• Option 2, Weaken, is also a synonym of undermine and means to make something weaker.(कमजोर)
 
• Option 3, Spoil, is not an antonym of undermine and means to damage or ruin something.(खराब करना)
